Liam (Support): Escalation: AtlasAI trial blocked by content ingestion errors (422 invalid-payload). Trial ends in 6 days, TAM flags renewal risk. Can CS own comms and offer a short-term path? @Maya

Zoe (Support Eng): Logs: ```2026-03-24T08:41:12Z ERROR ingest id=at-99 status=422 error=dim_mismatch expected=1536 got=0``` Looks like SDK sending empty vectors intermittently; also saw gzip truncation.

systems-bot: Alert S-2026-981 created for atlasai-ingest-blocker (priority: high).

Maya (CS): I'll own comms. Proposed plan: 1) Immediate ack to TAM + customer (ETA 30m). 2) Offer CSV upload of precomputed vectors as temporary ingress. 3) Pairing call within 4h to validate SDK and token rotation. 4) If unresolved, propose 7-day trial extension and mark renewal as at-risk.

Rafael (CSM): I'll update renewal tracker and loop in finance for credit contingency.

Zoe (Support Eng): I'll enable manual ingest endpoint for their tenant and put a dim-check with clearer errors. Posting curl example when ready.

Maya (CS): Sending ack now and scheduling pairing call. Will post updates here after the call.
